name: Bug report
about: Report a bug or an unexpected behavior
title: "[BUG] "
labels: bug
assignees: ''
---

## Environment

- **kute version:** (visible in the window header, e.g. `v9999` or `v1.2-rc1`)
- **OS:** Linux / Windows
- **Distro / Windows version:** (e.g. Ubuntu 24.04, Fedora 40, Windows 11 23H2)
- **Desktop / WM:** (Linux only — e.g. GNOME, KDE, Hyprland, i3, Sway)
- **Display server:** (Linux only — Wayland or X11)

## Description

A clear and short description of what the bug is.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Open the app
2. Click on '...'
3. See error

## Expected behavior

What you expected to happen.

## Actual behavior

What actually happened. Include any error text or unexpected UI state.

## Screenshots / videos

If applicable, attach screenshots or a short screen recording that shows the issue.

## Logs

The app writes a debug log to:
- Linux: `/tmp/kute_debug.log`
- Windows: `%TEMP%\kute_debug.log`

Attach the relevant part of the log (or the whole file if it's small).

## Additional context

Anything else that might be relevant — recent changes, when it started happening, whether it's reproducible every time, etc.
